b: Clapton Hymns, Vol. 1 collects 12 live performance recordings captured at the London event series
Church Of Sounds has launched a record label, and its first release is a compilation made up of live performance recordings captured at the London event series.

Taking in 12 tracks, Clapton Hymns, Vol. 1 features recordings by Tortoise's Jeff Parker, Moses Boyd's Exodus and Collocutor, among others. Perhaps the standout, though, is a performance by Tony Allen of 'Never (Lagos Never Gonna Be The Same)', which was captured during the legendary Nigerian artist's final live show just 48 days before his death.
